method: inferred from LWS opsin spectral tuning sites (sequence), not measured spectrally
conditions: L cones confirmed by immunohistochemistry in the four owl species

source.authors: Vasconcelos FTGR, Naman MJV, Hauzman E, Baron J, Ventura DF, Bonci DMO
source.title: LWS visual pigment in owls: Spectral tuning inferred by genetics

quote: No other variation was found in the spectral tuning sites of the LWS opsin, among the other species, and the λmax was estimated at around 555 nm.
note: Opsin-gene inference, not a pigment measurement. The sentence says 'the other species' (all studied owls except the burrowing owl Athene cunicularia, whose LWS differs); T. furcata is among the five species studied. Citation verified on 26 October 2026 against PMID 31706045 (Europe PMC MEDLINE record), the publisher listing and OpenAlex W2985825623. Abstract only; full-text methods and tables were not read. Findings 2486 and 2501 concern the DOI, not a demonstrated error in this genetic estimate.
